description: This Scala source file defines the HiveTempPath class used for managing temporary staging paths in Hive integration within Spark SQL. It handles creation, deletion, and path resolution for staging directories during Hive table operations.

classes.name: HiveTempPath
classes.description: A class for managing temporary staging paths used during Hive operations in Spark SQL, including creation, deletion, and path resolution.

methods.name: getExternalTmpPath
methods.description: Determines the external temporary path based on the input path and Hive version.

methods.name: externalTempPath
methods.description: Constructs the external temporary path, handling different URI schemes.

methods.name: getExternalScratchDir
methods.description: Gets the external scratch directory URI for staging.

methods.name: getStagingDir
methods.description: Calculates the staging directory path, ensuring it is a subdirectory and not deleted accidentally.

methods.name: isSubDir
methods.description: Checks if one path is a subdirectory of another.

methods.name: executionId
methods.description: Generates a unique execution ID string based on current time and a random number.

methods.name: deleteTmpPath
methods.description: Deletes the temporary staging directory if it exists.

methods.name: createTmpPath
methods.description: Creates the staging directory, throwing an error if creation fails.

methods.name: deleteIfNotStagingDir
methods.description: Deletes a path if it is not the staging directory.
